description: Send LLM-generated Markdown to Telegram, Slack, GitHub and Notion without it breaking: repaired, rendered per channel, split within its limit, streaming too. Rust core, npm (WASM, React), Go, CLI.
rules: Pass the model's Markdown to mdwire as is: do not pre-escape it or run it through another Markdown converter first.
Pick the channel by where the text goes: telegram-html with parse_mode "HTML", slack-markdown as chat.postMessage markdown_text, github-markdown, notion-markdown, plain, or html for innerHTML.
render returns an array of parts; send each part as its own message, in order.

When streaming, push() output is final. A channel that redraws the whole message sends accumulated output + preview(); an append-only channel (Slack appendStream) sends each push() piece and never calls preview().
renderWithReport results, their repairs and Streamer live in WASM memory: call free() or use `using`.
Under Vite, add vite-plugin-wasm and set build.target to "esnext".
From Python or any other language, pipe through the mdwire CLI: parts are separated by NUL.
